theorems.name: Submission.frt_weight_null_of_hausdorff_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (Z : Set (Euclidean N)), μHE[n] Z = 0 → (∀ x ∈ Z, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, θ ≠ ∞ ∧ HasDensity n μ x θ) → μ Z = 0
